navigationLaw: Knowledge sources are independently reachable. The critical path requires enough authored interpretation to identify the corridor; no sage, optional region or Highmoore boss becomes mandatory.

actors.name: C05_03_Jacinta
actors.text: Deep water is not empty water. Watch what the birds refuse to cross and what the tide carries back.

actors.name: C05_03_Seruni
actors.text: Draven hides a road by making every ordinary captain afraid of it. Fear is a chart too.

actors.name: C05_03_FjordVoice
actors.text: The cold current bends south before the black shoal. A ship entering there can vanish from every coast watcher.

actors.name: C05_03_Sailor
actors.text: Put the Harlow errors beside the war current. They stop being mistakes and become a corridor.

actors.name: C05_03_DeepRouteProof
actors.title: Reconstructed deep-water corridor
actors.body: Family chart habits, Ethan's false bearings, tide drift and the courier times intersect on one navigable corridor used by the Armada.
